capabilities: Build note-creation workflows as Canvas graphs walked by a wizard
Read PDFs, EPUBs and articles with highlights, ink and side notes
Cite passages in Markdown, Pandoc, BibTeX or CSL JSON
Run review loops that return highlights and claims from Home
Build dashboards from Obsidian Bases with stat, bar and heatmap panels
extras: AI is strictly optional: every loop and view works with AI disabled, and the README details exactly when and what is sent. The Script action and dynamic selectors run user JavaScript with vault access, so only trusted scripts should be run. Development is community-supported via a GitHub star or donation.
intentEvidence: It turns a native Canvas into a note-creation wizard
motivation: The README argues most plugins help you write but almost none help you think, and positions ZettelFlow as the engine that makes knowledge evolve.
problem: Obsidian has no guided way to create notes from a drawn workflow, and reading PDFs or EPUBs doesn't connect highlights back into the linked note graph.

relations.evidence: Your Library puts your PDFs, EPUBs and Web Clipper articles on one shelf

summary: Canvas-based note-creation wizard plus a Reader for PDFs, EPUBs and articles, with review loops that turn highlights into cited Zettelkasten notes.
